content.title: Home Mortgage Loans and Services: Get Pre-Approved | Truist Bank
content.text: Audio description: Upbeat guitar music begins to play. Visual Description and On-Screen Text: Welcome to Truist Mortgage Voiceover: Welcome to Truist Mortgage. Visual Description and On-Screen Text: Start your journey to homeownership today with the Truist online application. Voiceover: Start your journey to homeownership today with the Truist online application. Visual Description: Sunlight pours through treetops. A woman takes a small dog and a larger dog for a walk. A man is mowing his front lawn. Voiceover: Home means something different to everyone. Visual Description: An older couple shares drinks and a conversation on their front porch. A man and woman throw a baseball back and forth in their lawn as another couple looks on. Voiceover: It’s a place you love. A place as unique as you are. Visual Description: A woman walks through her front yard towards the street and smiles. Audio Description: The sound of a bicycle changing gears. Upbeat guitar music swells. Voiceover: A place where you can be yourself. Visual Description: A boy rides his bike down a neighborhood street. Nearby, a group of children with water squirters are chased by their parents, shrieking with happiness. Voiceover: It’s a place to grow into and a place to come back to. Visual Description: A man speaks with a builder outside of his house, construction nearly completed. A man in military fatigues walks towards a front porch where a sign that says “Welcome Home” hangs. Voiceover: It’s a place for life’s moments, big and small. Visual Description: A toddler helps her parents unload a moving van in the front yard of their home. She carries a box labeled “Maya’s Toys” to her mother. Voiceover: And moments that last a lifetime. Visual Description: A boy with a blindfold on swings a bat wildly in the direction of a piñata. A family takes a selfie together in front of their home. Voiceover: Whatever matters most to you, we’re here to open the door, Visual Description: While the blindfolded boy continues to swing at the piñata, the rest of the group at the party smiles and poses for the camera as a group. The children with water squirters spray each other as their parents smile from Adirondack chairs in the front yard. Voiceover: and we’re pursuing innovative solutions to give you the right mix of human touch and new technology, Visual Description: The toddler and her parents smile in their front yard alongside their dog. The woman walking her dogs sits down in the grass to pet them. Voiceover: and the financial guidance you need to achieve more. Visual Description: The man in military fatigues smiles in his front lawn. The man speaking with a builder puts his hands in his pockets and smiles. Voiceover: Welcome to Truist Mortgage. Your journey home starts today. Visual Description: A blue sky fades to white and the Truist logo appears. Onscreen text: Contact your Truist loan officer for more information. Onscreen text: Truist Bank is an Equal Housing Lender. Copyright 2024 Truist Financial Corporation. Truist, the Truist logo, and Truist Purple are service marks of Truist Financial Corporation and used with Permission. Voiceover: Ready to apply now? Contact your Truist loan officer to get started today. Audio Description: Music fades out.
